comply_text: Every level: floor-to-ceiling >= 3000 mm; basement >= 2500 mm
not_comply_text: Any level < 3000 mm (or basement < 2500 mm) — list the level + the actual value

comply_text: Single-leaf door >= 900 mm; double >= 1500 mm; clear height >= 2100 mm
not_comply_text: Any door type below the minimum — list `Type | width | height`

comply_text: Main door: solid core and thickness >= 40 mm (thickness parameter filled)
not_comply_text: Thickness < 40 mm, or the parameter does not exist on the main door

comply_text: No RC flat roof; OR a flat roof AND a waterproofing / double-roofing element exists in the model
not_comply_text: An RC roof without a waterproofing layer or material — LISTED for a person (JKR gives no flat-roof definition), not an automatic ✗

comply_text: Decorative fence height >= 2400 mm
not_comply_text: Height < 2400 mm

comply_text: The file name has every required segment (>= 3 segments as the guidelines set)
not_comply_text: Segments incomplete / wrong format — show the segments detected

comply_text: Code detected: W00 (single model) or WXnn (split model) — carried to A3
not_comply_text: The code cannot be read from the file name

comply_text: Code = W00 → COMPLIES DIRECTLY (a one-piece model, e.g. a hall)
Every part file (WX01, WX02…) is present as a link in the model
not_comply_text: A part is not linked — list the missing files

comply_text: Every model file listed in the BPEP is found as a link
not_comply_text: A file in the BPEP is not in the model (or the other way round)

comply_text: Project Base Point exactly at Grid A/1 (0 mm)
not_comply_text: Offset is not 0 mm — show the offset in mm (X/Y); JKR gives no offset limit, a person decides

comply_text: Grids in order with no jumps: numbers 1,2,3,4… and letters A,B,C… (left→right or reversed, top→bottom or bottom→top — all accepted)
not_comply_text: A jump in the sequence (e.g. 1,2,3 → 11) — list the gaps

comply_text: A valid sub-grid pattern: 1A,1B,1C or A1,A2,A3 — listed under the main grid
not_comply_text: — (sub-grids are NOT counted as wrong)

comply_text: Every slab area has a defined room (lifts, stairs and aprons included)
not_comply_text: A slab without a room — list `Level | Grid location | Type (lift/stair/apron)`. A person decides whether it is an exception (lift, stair, apron)

comply_text: Department filled (if the project type needs it: hospital / office)
not_comply_text: — (DO NOT flag MAJOR just because Department is empty)

comply_text: Every element in every category has a material (not empty)
not_comply_text: Elements without a material — list `Category | Type name | No. of elements`

comply_text: Every field marked mandatory at the project LOI (PB p.30–34) is filled with a real value
not_comply_text: A mandatory field is empty OR still a Revit default — list `Parameter | Mandatory at LOI | Value | Status`
One 'Not compliant' row per discipline + a list of the unfilled fields only
